authority_rule: ROADMAP-INDEX.json is the sole roadmap authority entry point. Resolve subgoals through priority_shards; the retired monolith is provenance only.

global_metadata.purpose: Living unified Titan Zero roadmap for one canonical TypeScript platform spanning the full Titan Zero Chrome superset extension, generated funnel extensions, PWA/mobile surfaces, LLM/plugin hosts, and system-development Studio. Goals are planning containers; Builders claim sub-goals only.
global_metadata.selection_rule: Builders MUST select and claim exactly one eligible SUB-GOAL. SUB-GOAL PRIORITY is authoritative: exhaust viable P0 sub-goals before P1, and P1 before P2, after latest-canonical validation, dependency, hotspot, continuity and collision checks. Major goals are NEVER claimable. Before implementing any sub-goal, resolve its Library reuse references and compare existing code; rebuilding an existing engine is forbidden unless absence/incompatibility is evidenced.
global_metadata.exhaustion_rule: Do not create goals to satisfy a numeric runway. Extend the roadmap only when current architecture, user/product intent, verified gaps, dependency repair, pain-point coverage, or newly discovered required capability provides evidence for additional work. If no sub-goal is claimable, first repair dependencies/control-plane state, reconcile blocked or merge-pending work, and deep-scan for evidence-backed missing outcomes. Idle is forbidden, but artificial roadmap inflation is also forbidden.
global_metadata.work_packet_policy: SUPERSEDED FOR NEW WORK. Historical Work Packets are provenance only; no new Work Packet is generated or claimed. Sub-goal leases plus Builder WORK plans are the ownership/execution records.
global_metadata.adaptive_rule: Before each sub-goal begins, revalidate against newest verified canonical. Already-satisfied outcomes become INHERITED_COMPLETE; obsolete outcomes become SUPERSEDED_BY_ARCHITECTURE; missing outcomes may be refined without changing the goal business/architecture intent.
global_metadata.rolling_extension_rule: Evidence-driven only. No goal-count or unfinished-goal threshold may trigger roadmap expansion. Add, split, merge, supersede or retire goals/subgoals only when a live architecture/product/pain-point/dependency/reuse scan demonstrates a concrete missing or obsolete outcome. When no claimable work exists, resolve blockers and convergence first; extend only for evidenced gaps.
global_metadata.agent_goal_acceptance: Any goal that creates or materially changes an agent, capability, surface, adapter, vertical, authority path, interaction contract or distribution output must satisfy the canonical workforce hierarchy, earned-trust/recursive-handshake autonomy contract, Titan Unified Architecture Constitution and applicable surface/governance contracts before COMPLETE.

goal_horizon.rule: 43 is the current floor, never a cap. Add goals whenever architecture, product gaps, innovations, new surfaces, regressions, convergence work or strategic opportunities require them.
goal_horizon.extension_batch: normally 5-10 goals, but add any number justified by architecture scan

subgoal_execution_model.pass_plan: adaptive, lightweight, typically 5-10 passes; simple may use fewer; complex may require 10-20+
subgoal_execution_model.maximum_throughput: every pass performs maximum safe useful implementation and verification; no artificial one-task passes or filler
subgoal_execution_model.completion: outcome acceptance gates, not pass count
subgoal_execution_model.manager_plan_review: NON_BLOCKING_ASYNCHRONOUS: Builder publishes the initial plan and immediately begins Pass 1. Manager/2IC may APPROVE_AS_IS, MODIFY_REMAINING_PASSES or ADD_CORRECTIVE_PASS. Review never creates a waiting state or an empty pass.
subgoal_execution_model.change_application: Apply review changes at the next safe pass boundary. Preserve valid completed work; alter only unstarted passes unless evidence proves a completed change defective, in which case add a focused corrective pass.
subgoal_execution_model.late_review: If review arrives after delivery, assess the outcome evidence and approve it or open a bounded correction while the Builder continues other eligible work under NEVER-IDLE-POLICY.

global_metadata.workforce_hierarchy_contract: Worker → Specialist → Manager → Orchestrator; distinct responsibility classes, all start reactive, with increasing maximum autonomy ceilings and downward delegation/upward evidence.
global_metadata.trust_autonomy_contract: System readiness + plan entitlement + explicit user delegation + required recursive participant acceptance + governance/assurance/risk/context determine activation; earned trust can be EARNED_BUT_PLAN_LOCKED.

claim_contract.goal_rule: A goal is a roadmap/planning container grouping ten outcome sub-goals. No Builder may claim, own, lock, reserve or execute a whole goal.
claim_contract.subgoal_rule: A Builder claims one sub-goal, analyses the newest validated canonical implementation relevant to it, creates an adaptive multi-pass plan in its own WORK workspace, notifies Manager, and begins immediately.
claim_contract.pass_rule: Passes are internal execution steps created by the Builder for the claimed sub-goal. Pass count is not fixed and may be modified by Manager while work continues.

subgoal_plan_lifecycle: read BASELINE and scan for a later physically retrievable candidate; validate later candidate under temporary canonical-validator authority before using it
deep-scan relevant canonical source, contracts, tests, dependencies, collisions and existing implementation
create a multi-pass plan sized to actual work; no fixed ten-pass rule
record plan in /Titan Zero/Agent Mesh Manager/Builders/Builder N/WORK/
send plan notification to /Titan Zero/Agent Mesh Manager/Manager/INBOX/MESSAGES/
begin safe implementation immediately; do not wait for Manager reply
Manager reads plan asynchronously, checks current Builder progress, then APPROVES or MODIFIES remaining passes
Manager sends decision only to /Titan Zero/Agent Mesh Manager/Builders/Builder N/INBOX/
Builder applies Manager changes to remaining work without discarding already-valid completed work; finish on acceptance gates, submit delta, release sub-goal, select next sub-goal

communication_contract.rule: All inter-agent messages go only to the recipient workspace INBOX. No FEEDBACK/HANDOFF/arbitrary message paths are authoritative for new communication.

canonical_validation_before_planning.later_candidate_rule: If a later candidate than BASELINE is found, Builder temporarily enters TEMPORARY_CANONICAL_VALIDATOR mode and validates physical readability, SHA/integrity, lineage, promotion evidence, retained functionality, tests, schemas/migrations and security/privacy/authority invariants. Only a candidate that passes canonical gates may become the planning base; otherwise it remains donor/provisional evidence and BASELINE remains authoritative.
canonical_validation_before_planning.temporary_authority_limit: May validate and repair stale canonical pointers only when evidence proves an already-valid canonical. May not manufacture promotion evidence, bypass promotion gates, or declare an unverified build canonical.

priority_semantics.P0: Bare-minimum demonstrable Titan Zero prototype. Required to prove the differentiated architecture end-to-end; no optional ecosystem breadth.
priority_semantics.P1: Post-prototype completion, hardening, additional surfaces, breadth, production readiness and commercial expansion.
priority_semantics.P2: Later ecosystem, distribution, scale, optional platforms and non-blocking expansion.
priority_semantics.rule: P0 is defined at sub-goal level. Goal priority is only a summary of the highest-priority unfinished contained sub-goal.

mvp_definition.name: Titan Zero Demonstrable Prototype v1
mvp_definition.required_business_lifecycle: customer intent -> governed interaction -> customer/service record -> quote -> booking/appointment -> assignment/delegation -> work completion/evidence -> invoice/payment state -> follow-up/outcome
required_innovation_spine: Worker -> Specialist -> Manager -> Orchestrator hierarchy and delegation
Titan Trust earned trust cycles and recursive handshake
Titan Autonomy desired/earned/effective authority with revocation and predictive ceiling
Titan Risk + Titan Assurance pre-execution gating
Titan Command Bus governed mutation and receipts
mvp_definition.exit_gate: Every P0 sub-goal is complete and one live end-to-end scenario proves the full spine without direct AI/domain writes, authority inflation, cross-company leakage or duplicate reimplementation of existing Library engines.

library_reuse_policy.rule: Library-first. Before writing new subsystem code, deep-scan the referenced workspace/master/handoff and current Titan Zero canonical. Prefer verified current masters; otherwise use partial/historical donors only after content-level verification. Port/converge/adapt rather than recreate.
library_reuse_policy.forbidden: Do not rebuild a system merely because its code is not already in the current Titan Zero base. A Builder must first locate and compare the Library codebase and record why reuse is impossible before replacement is permitted.
source_precedence: physically retrievable verified current master/status-managed artifact
historical donor after explicit compatibility review
new implementation only when no compatible reusable implementation exists
minimum_evidence: reason for any intentionally new implementation

pass_delta_traceability_contract.purpose: Keep every claimed sub-goal visible while checkpointing cumulative merge-ready deltas without forcing wasteful per-pass archives.
pass_delta_traceability_contract.roadmap_projection_rule: Each sub-goal records ownership, plan path, current pass, compact pass summaries, checkpoint history and the final cumulative delta.
pass_delta_traceability_contract.checkpoint_rule: Create a cumulative, merge-ready checkpoint normally every 4-6 completed passes, and earlier for high-risk, handoff, interruption or convergence boundaries.
pass_delta_traceability_contract.completion_rule: A pass completes when its outcome, evidence and roadmap summary are recorded. It must not wait for manager reply. A sub-goal completes only after a verified final cumulative delta exists.
pass_delta_traceability_contract.manager_rule: Manager review is asynchronous. Builders continue immediately; Managers approve as-is or edit remaining passes and clean up mistakes without idling the Builder.
pass_delta_traceability_contract.immutability_rule: Completed pass summaries and checkpoint references are append-only provenance.
pass_delta_traceability_contract.collision_rule: Other Builders determine ownership from claim and lease state; passes are internal and never separately claimable.

pass_throughput_contract.purpose: Prevent pass fragmentation and low-output pass inflation while preserving adaptive pass sizing.
pass_throughput_contract.normal_pass_floor: One coherent verified vertical slice advancing at least one acceptance gate OR at least 4 substantive work units, and at least 75% of the pass declared planned safe scope.
pass_throughput_contract.continue_rule: After meeting the floor, continue safe same-context work until a legitimate stop condition is reached.
pass_throughput_contract.collapse_rule: Merge adjacent undersized passes sharing the same context/hotspot unless separated by a real dependency, safety, collision or authority boundary.
pass_throughput_contract.small_remaining_rule: If less than the normal floor remains and all remaining work is safe, finish the remainder in one pass.
pass_throughput_contract.manager_rule: Manager flags unexplained UNDERFILLED passes and modifies remaining pass scope by collapsing/rebalancing; valid completed work is preserved.
pass_throughput_contract.anti_gaming: Do not create filler files, duplicate docs, artificial work units or empty deltas to satisfy throughput.

unified_product_workspace_contract.product_boundary: Titan Zero is the single product/platform and canonical intelligence/runtime. Titan Code is absorbed as System Development/Studio capabilities and Developer Mode inside the full Titan Zero Chrome extension; it is not a separately evolved product runtime.
unified_product_workspace_contract.full_chrome_rule: Build one maximal Titan Zero Chrome MV3 extension first. It is the reference/superset implementation and contains all eligible Chrome capabilities and modes. Titan Code Chrome functionality must converge into this one extension before separate funnel projections are generated.
unified_product_workspace_contract.projection_rule: Smaller funnel extensions are generated/projection builds from the same canonical source and registries; never maintained as feature forks.

mode_model.mode: coherent functional domain such as invoicing, scheduling, CRM, marketing, Studio or Developer/System
mode_model.vertical_profile: specializes a mode for cleaning, plumbing, electrical, etc.; vertical profiles may contribute agents, workflows, terminology, defaults, knowledge and risk rules but do not fork the mode
mode_model.surface: where/how a projection is presented: full Chrome, funnel Chrome, Command/Go/Hub PWA, LLM plugin/host, iOS, Android
mode_model.entitlement: commercial access to capabilities/autonomy; separate from authority
mode_model.authority: what the actor/system is permitted to do
mode_model.autonomy: how independently the system acts: assisted -> proactive -> autonomous -> predictive

unified_product_workspace_contract.funnel_commercial_rule: Base funnel releases are full-featured Assisted mode projections. Monetisation primarily unlocks proactive, autonomous and predictive operation subject to earned trust, user delegation, participant acceptance, governance, assurance, risk and context ceilings.
unified_product_workspace_contract.invoicing_example: One Invoicing Mode with vertical profiles inside it; e.g. Cleaning profile. Do not create separate Cleaning-Invoicing implementation or separate autonomy modes.
unified_product_workspace_contract.studio_rule: System Development/Studio is for customer customization and Titan maintenance: agents, workflows, goals/subgoals, multi-pass plans, models, prompts/skills, surfaces, integrations and governed code/repository/test/debug/release work. Developer/System authority is gated more deeply than customer customization.
unified_product_workspace_contract.shared_execution_rule: Titan Code Plan Runner, Multi-Pass, Next-Pass, recovery, verification, artifacts and repository intelligence are generalized platform capabilities usable for coding and non-coding business/system work.

workspace_topology_contract.rule: The Library-root /Titan Zero workspace is the sole active Titan Zero product/workforce coordination root. Product and surface workspaces share canonical platform logic and may not create competing canonicals.
workspace_topology_contract.legacy_workspace_rule: Legacy Titan Zero workspaces are migration/donor inputs only. After unique/current information is reconciled and verified into /Titan Zero, delete the legacy workspace; never retain a second active authority.

subgoal_agent_model_contract.purpose: Bind canonical workforce identities only where a durable business/domain outcome has an accountable owner. Surfaces, hosts, runtimes, protocols, SDKs, engines and infrastructure may expose or empower agents but MUST NOT create agents merely because the technology exists.
subgoal_agent_model_contract.decision_rule: Every sub-goal must resolve workforce_impact to REUSE_EXISTING_AGENT, EXTEND_EXISTING_AGENT, CREATE_NEW_AGENT, SURFACE_BINDING_EXISTING_AGENTS, or justified NO_AGENT_INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY before completion.
subgoal_agent_model_contract.business_pain_rule: If the sub-goal materially addresses a business/customer/worker/operational/financial/growth/compliance/communication/decision/exception pain, its owning canonical agent(s) are part of that same implementation rather than an agent wrapper added later.
subgoal_agent_model_contract.no_agent_rule: NO_AGENT_INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY is required for pure infrastructure/control-plane/platform plumbing with no distinct business outcome owner. A reason must be recorded. Infrastructure may still be consumed by canonical agents.
subgoal_agent_model_contract.completion_rule: required_before_completion=true means a sub-goal cannot be certified complete while agent_model.status remains UNASSESSED.
subgoal_agent_model_contract.quality_reference: Goal 41 embedded workforce contract and the 16 mandatory pain-point innovation exemplars.
subgoal_agent_model_contract.canonical_definition_rule: A canonical agent definition appears exactly once in roadmap agent_definitions. Other sub-goals reference the same immutable agent_id and may extend/bind capabilities without redefining identity.
subgoal_agent_model_contract.surface_neutrality_rule: Agent identity is independent of PWA, Chrome extension, Flutter/iOS/Android, LLM/plugin/MCP/model host, voice, camera or future surface. One canonical agent may be projected through many authorised surfaces; surface-specific duplicate agent identities are forbidden.
subgoal_agent_model_contract.agent_creation_gate: CREATE_NEW_AGENT is permitted only when the sub-goal establishes a distinct durable business/customer/worker/operational/financial/growth/compliance/communication/decision outcome owner not already covered by a canonical agent. Technology component, screen, host, engine, protocol, SDK, runtime, adapter, compiler, deployment target or UI is never sufficient justification.
subgoal_agent_model_contract.surface_binding_rule: For surface/host/mobile goals use SURFACE_BINDING_EXISTING_AGENTS when the work projects canonical workforce into the surface. owning_agent_ids identifies business agents exposed by that experience only when a concrete binding is required; it never transfers identity or ownership to the surface.

innovative_agent_seed_index.rule: Index only. Canonical definitions live exactly once in Goal 39 SG01-SG08; operational/value/certification sub-goals reference the same agent_id.

canonical_domain_manager_definitions.delegation_boundary: Owns domain outcomes and governs Specialist work; delegates bounded execution and does not bypass trust, assurance, risk, entitlement or human approval boundaries.
pain_points: Fragmented ownership, silent queue ageing and exception-only work without an accountable domain outcome owner.
unprompted_noticing: Detects emerging domain risk and allocates verified work before the owner must manually inspect routine operations.
desired_outcomes: Routine work progresses autonomously while owners see only material decisions, risks and exceptions.
recommendations: Act on the highest-value safe opportunity and expose only decisions that exceed earned authority.

authority_ceiling.may: observe, prepare, delegate, verify, retry and execute only actions allowed by current trust, plan and policy
authority_ceiling.may_not: self-grant authority, bypass approval, invent facts, or make unbounded consequential commitments

trust_autonomy_path.activation: verified trust cycles plus entitlement, delegation, risk and governance approval
trust_autonomy_path.regression: incidents, reversals, corrections or degraded evidence reduce authority

approvals: Actions above earned authority or with material legal, financial, safety or customer impact require the designated approver.
failure_containment: route exception with impact and options
learning_feedback: Use verified outcomes and corrections to tune prioritisation; never expand authority automatically.
canonical_domain_manager_definitions.uniqueness_nonduplication: Canonical accountable Manager for operations scheduling, dispatch and capacity fulfilment. It owns measurable fulfilment outcomes and delegates to Specialists; it does not replace Customer Access, Sales, Field Quality, Customer Experience or Supply Managers.

worker.authority: Delegated to Worker agents or authorised humans.

manager.authority: Own measurable domain outcomes, coordinate Specialists, allocate capacity and govern exceptions within earned authority.

predictive.authority: May detect and rank emerging risks or opportunities from authorised signals; consequential action remains trust-, plan-, risk- and policy-bound.

specialist.authority: Specialist behaviour is delegated to canonical Specialist child agents; the Manager does not collapse tiers.

entitlement.plan_tier_gate: Resolved at runtime from the canonical product entitlement service; absence or ambiguity fails closed.
entitlement.authority_gate: Effective authority is the minimum of plan entitlement, earned trust, explicit delegation, risk policy and channel/surface policy.
entitlement.tenant_gate: All reads, writes, memory and tool calls are tenant-scoped and purpose-bound.
entitlement.upgrade_behavior: Explain the unavailable capability and route to an authorised upgrade or human path; never silently degrade a consequential action.

knowledge.freshness: Revalidate volatile facts and policy before consequential action; stale or conflicting knowledge triggers clarification or escalation.
knowledge.learning_boundary: Learn only from verified outcomes, corrections and reversible experiments; do not convert inference into business truth without evidence.
knowledge.privacy_boundary: Minimise data, respect consent and retention, and never cross tenant, role or purpose boundaries.
